panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子伸手指向厨房方向（拿榴莲）；表情不耐烦升级（眉头更紧、嘴张得更大）；语气比 14.03 急。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 李斌快点快点，把榴莲拿出来。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman on the grey sofa, one arm now more emphatically extended toward the off-frame kitchen direction, the index finger pointing. Impatient expression escalating — eyes still averted from the husband direction but with a slight narrowing, eyebrows drawn down a touch more from the previous frame, mouth opening wider mid-command. Long straight black hair completely down, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, light grey high-waisted yoga leggings, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the pointing hand. Warm yellow-white living room light. Mood: the second summon, the impatience growing louder. Text watermark 'P14-PN04' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, romantic soft lighting, dramatic shadows
